card.name: Start of hypo- and related medical terms
card.fires_on: The opening piece of a longer medical term, mostly "hyp" in hypoplasia, hypokalemia or hypoparathyroidism. It also fires on "bone" before "pain" and on "ro" in fibrovascular.
